column1: # Singletons with inline per-player [12] arrays, relocated by scripts/mkw100/array_sites.py and
# runtime/src/hle/array_overflow.cpp. Ids are the translator's class ids; never reuse one.
# size is the allocation (AI::Manager::createInstance: li r3, 0x9C); it bounds the shadow window.
# instance is the singleton pointer's guest address, or 0xGLOBAL+0xMEMBER for an object the
# singleton points to at that member. ctor (optional): the class's constructor, whose `this` is
# trusted as the instance; the runtime must publish the instance before it runs.
# id  name        instance         size  arrays(offset:stride)  access-map  [ctor]
